chunks: The worst form of usury is lying.

key_terms.أَرْبَى الرِّبَا: the most severe or worst kind of usury

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying that the worst usury is lying?
ai.summary: This prophetic saying condemns lying in the strongest terms by likening it to the gravest form of riba. It highlights the severe moral corruption of falsehood and warns that dishonesty is among the most destructive sins in human dealings.
